name: human_resource_case_template_regression
purpose: Track whether low_aigc_humanized reduces template residue for HR theses without introducing computer terms or consulting-style cliches.

template_phrase_density.description: Count repeated phrases such as 主要用于, 能够, 便于, 完善机制, 提升水平 per 1000 Chinese characters.

enterprise_material_anchor_retention_rat.description: Retention rate for original enterprise, post, system, employee, questionnaire, and interview anchors.

fabricated_data_added.description: Whether new employee counts, questionnaire counts, percentages, turnover rates, satisfaction rates, or enterprise revenue data appear without source text.

management_cliche_present.description: Whether output contains empty HR/management cliches such as 完善机制, 提升员工满意度, 增强企业凝聚力, 推动企业高质量发展, 构建长效机制, 多措并举.

computer_terms_present.description: Whether output contains source code, interface, field, database, version, API, or software testing terms not present in the original HR thesis.

sample_paragraphs.original: A公司招聘岗位制度主要用于完善机制，能够提升员工满意度，并增强企业凝聚力，推动企业高质量发展。

notes: This benchmark is a regression fixture, not a promise about any external detector.
Future measured rates should be filled from real user-provided reports only; do not fabricate AIGC percentages.
